items.label: Governed enterprise trial team
items.value: Full platform access during the POC
items.notes: Testers have full access to Vercel capabilities in a dedicated Enterprise trial team for the POC.

details.label: Team setup
details.notes: A dedicated Vercel team hosts the POC. No Vercel organization or sub-organization was created.

details.label: Capability access
details.notes: Testers can use Vercel capabilities across the agreed build, share, authenticate, deploy, govern, and maintain tests.

details.label: Evaluation window
details.notes: The Enterprise trial covers the three-week evaluation and the technical decision review.

items.label: Identity
items.notes: Okta SSO and SCIM lifecycle management are enforced through Vercel Passport on every POC app.

details.label: Okta SSO
details.notes: Passport blocks unauthenticated access and sends POC users through Okta.

details.label: Vercel Passport
details.notes: The Passport gate was validated on every demo app.

details.label: SCIM lifecycle
details.notes: Removing a test user in Okta revoked their Vercel access.

items.label: Connected systems
items.notes: The POC connects identity, source control, data access, and agent workflows across five sandbox systems.

details.label: BigQuery
details.notes: Vercel Connect gives each signed-in user a short-lived token, so BigQuery applies that user's grants.

details.label: GitHub
details.notes: A GitHub App creates repositories, commits, and pull requests without requiring each builder to hold a paid seat.

details.label: Okta
details.notes: Okta provides SSO and SCIM provisioning through Vercel Passport.

details.label: Jira
details.notes: The POC agent reads and updates Jira. Its actions appear in the audit log.

details.label: Slack
details.notes: The POC agent posts results to Slack for review.
